context: Aoi attends Sho-young's little league soccer match; cheering supportively.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet, trembling voice on the opening. A small boy's worry breaking through — earnest, not performed. Soft pace, seeking reassurance. Slight catch before the final word.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Warm, steady voice that settles him. Gentle conviction — not dismissing his worry but anchoring him. Slow, deliberate pace. Eyes soft on him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small voice but firmer now. A child gathering himself. Energy shifting from worry to resolve. Quick, decisive attack on the affirmation. Still young, but determined.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Bright, encouraging, pushing him forward. Light lift in the voice — permission to stop worrying and start enjoying. Quick pace, almost bouncing. Genuine cheer, not hollow cheerleading.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Sudden energy — the worry burned off. Bright, urgent, a boy ready to run. Quick, almost breathless delivery. Joy underneath the excitement. Off he goes.
